title: Container Bookings: position of a carrier roll within the compensated-roll limit
content:
## Rule
For Container Bookings roll compensation, the roll being compensated takes the position one above the number of roll compensation entries already on the booking, and it earns compensation only while that position does not exceed the tier's number of compensated carrier rolls.

## Boundary table (hypothetical limit of 2)
| Compensation entries already on the booking | Position of the roll being compensated | Earns compensation |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 1 | yes |
| 1 | 2 | yes |
| 2 | 3 | no |

On a tier whose number of compensated carrier rolls is 0, the first position is already above the limit, so no roll earns compensation.

## Wrong reading and correct basis
*Hypothetical booking, for illustration only:* three carrier rolls are recorded, one compensation entry exists, and the tier's limit is 2.
| Wrong reading | Correct basis |
|---|---|
| Count all carrier rolls including this one (3), which exceeds 2, so nothing is due. | The position is one above the compensation entries already on the booking: 1 plus one gives position 2, which does not exceed 2, so this roll earns compensation. |
